$schema: UI Surface Registry — tracks status of every shell surface in convergence
convergencePhase: Claude Design bundle adoption — Phase 1 Home surface live (ClaudeHome) · tokens ported from docs/design/concept2cure-design-system/project/colors_and_type.css
designAuthority: docs/design/concept2cure-design-system/ (Claude Design handoff bundle) + direct user instructions (per CLAUDE.md UI Source of Truth section)

ClaudeHome.tsx.role: Canonical home surface — exact mirror of docs/design/concept2cure-design-system/project/ui_kits/home/App.jsx. Owns the entire viewport when layoutMode === 'projects' && !embeddedModule. Full shell: rail (15 nav items, 4 groups) · topbar (crumbs + scope switcher + workspace pill + tb actions) · page body (greeting + composer + suggestion pills + AnA briefing card + dashboard strip + module launcher + recents) · ⌘K command palette. Rendered from ZenApp.tsx via early return.
ClaudeHome.tsx.bundleDeviations: TweaksPanel + canvas postMessage protocol omitted (canvas-only, not product). User data from real auth instead of hardcoded Jordan/JC/Enterprise. Icons via lucide-react. CSS via CSS Modules.
ClaudeHome.tsx.supersedes: Prior ZenApp.tsx projects-layout home (ZenSidebar + thin top bar + AnaPersistentPanel full mode). Render branch DELETED.

ZenApp.tsx.role: Primary application shell — owns all non-home layouts (workspace, editor, project-home, etc.). Home layout (layoutMode === 'projects') short-circuits to ClaudeHome via early return. The prior home render branch (old thin top bar + AnaPersistentPanel full mode) has been deleted.
ZenApp.tsx.projectLanding: 2026-04-06 WO-2: ProjectHomeDashboard rewritten — back link, hero title, description only. Right rail (ProjectKnowledgePanel) preserved.

ZenRouter.tsx.role: URL routing dispatcher — funnels all paths to ZenApp

ZenShell.tsx.role: Former alternative shell — confirmed orphaned and deleted

SplitScreenLayout.tsx.role: Former split-screen layout — confirmed orphaned and deleted

IndustryWorkspaceShell.tsx.role: Former industry-aware shell — confirmed orphaned and deleted

GlobalOperatingShell.tsx.role: Former breadcrumb wrapper — deleted, replaced with plain div

ZenSidebar.tsx.defaultState: collapsed-icon-rail (WO-8, 2026-04-14) — thin ~56px rail is the default; user can expand to 260px via the chevron
ZenSidebar.tsx.role: Left sidebar — single canonical nav source with 7 destinations (collapsed icon rail is default)
ZenSidebar.tsx.workspaceSectionRemoved: 2026-04-06 — Removed Tools, Editor, Intelligence, Review & Verify, References, Submit & Export from global sidebar per ChatGPT parity design constitution
ZenSidebar.tsx.wo8Changes: 2026-04-14 WO-8: Relabeled Workspace Home → Home, Vault → Artifacts. Added Apps (LayoutGrid) and Settings (gear) icons. Changed Intelligence icon from Settings-gear to Brain. Expanded nav mirrors the rail order.

Sidebar.tsx (legacy).role: Former generic sidebar — confirmed orphaned and deleted

zen-app-constants.ts.role: 7 canonical LayoutMode values + WorkspaceView sub-routing. All project-scoped modes consolidated.

zenRouteNormalization.ts.role: Redirect map for 85+ demoted layout modes → 7 active destinations

AnaPersistentPanel.tsx.rationale: Phase 2 Claude Design convergence. AnaPersistentPanel was the legacy chat surface; it is fully replaced by the Claude Design bundle-faithful ClaudeAna shell. Legacy features not represented in the bundle (slash-command menu, @-mention autocomplete, Save-to-Vault inline, chat-mode switcher, deep-research/nano-banana modes, drag-drop attach) are dropped with the legacy component per CLAUDE.md: the bundle is the design authority and the Claude Code implementer does not carry forward features the designer has not shipped.

ClaudeAna.role: Canonical AnA RI chat surface — Phase 2 Claude Design port. Mirror of docs/design/concept2cure-design-system/project/ui_kits/ana_ri/.
ClaudeAna.streamingContract: POST /api/ana-ri/stream (SSE: status / thread_id / orchestration / text / done / post_done / warning / grounding_strip / error)

functionalAdditions.stopWhileStreaming: Send button flips to stop icon (same 32×32, Square icon) — bundle's composer-send pattern reused
functionalAdditions.latencyChip: Muted .cite pill next to AI name header
functionalAdditions.degradedBadge: Muted .cite pill for Cortex fallback / persistence failure
functionalAdditions.executedActionChips: .suggest-pill pattern below assistant reply, clickable when artifactId or sectionCode present
functionalAdditions.userEditRegenerate: Hover-revealed pencil on user bubble → Composer for inline edit-and-resubmit

chats.component: ClaudeHome (Phase 1) for layoutMode=projects; ClaudeAna (Phase 2) inside workspace layouts
chats.notes: Home handled by ClaudeHome early return; workspace chat by ClaudeAna.

projects.notes: Phase 1 Claude Design home render. See components/claude-home/.

communication-center.notes: Promoted from sub-view to top-level destination in Phase 4.

reports.position: sidebar Zone B, between Projects and Communication Center
reports.notes: 2026-04-06 Reporting & Analytics elevated to core sidebar destination. Renders IntelligentReportGenerator at the global level (not project-scoped). Excluded from catch-all AnaPersistentPanel since it owns its full canvas. Backend: /api/intelligent-reports/*, /api/report-os/*, /api/analytics-routes.

apps.notes: 2026-04-14 WO-9: AppsPage expanded from 8 cards in 3 categories to 25 cards in 4 categories matching server KNOWN_APP_IDS exactly. Previously-hidden apps surfaced: device-strategy, ind-authoring, cmc, report-engine, regulatory-intelligence (RIM), csr-intelligence, protocol-designer, device-engineering, dossier-navigator, ectd-navigator, document-vault, sop-management, capa-management, post-market, inspection-readiness, compliance-monitor, evidence-engine. Nav handler extended with two new resolver paths: (a) tool-panel mapping for apps that live as project-scoped drawers (ectd, protocol, sop, capa, pms, inspection, intelligence, vault); (b) seed-chat starters for apps that open project-home with an AnA-contextual prompt (device-strategy, ind-authoring, cmc, safety-narrative, report-engine, csr-intelligence, device-engineering, dossier-navigator, compliance-monitor, evidence-engine). All 25 cards visible (disabled if no active project). No new component files.

tabs.personal: UserContextEditor — role, expertise, response style, custom context
tabs.company: CompanyContextEditor — company profile, regulatory markets, pipeline, SOPs
tabs.project: ProjectContextEditor — submission type, target agencies, risks, instructions

customize.notes: 2026-04-06 WO-4: First-class sidebar entry for regulatory intelligence configuration. 3-tier: user → organization → project.

toolPanels.role: Canonical right-side context drawer with Tool|Context tabs. ProjectKnowledgePanel renders in Context tab.

fonts.heading: DM Sans / system sans
fonts.notes: Poppins removed from all shell surfaces (0 remaining in client/). Lora isolated to document editor surfaces.

colors.notes: Stone palette is the foundation. Color reserved for semantic meaning only (emerald=success, amber=warning, red=error, blue=links).
